heading: Four stages.
why: We agree on layout, content and behavior on paper first, so nothing gets rebuilt.

steps.title: Listen
steps.text: We start with your goals, requirements and timeline.

steps.title: Draft
steps.text: You review drawings of every key page before we build.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: We code the site and test it on real devices.

steps.title: Launch
steps.text: We go live, train your team and stay on for the first weeks.
